div.h1: PR #1 - texture pipeline: pack once, load natively
div.p: 17 files and manual slicing replaced by 2 spritesheets PixiJS reads itself.

g.text: BUILD TIME: npm run assets:pack (Node, tools/pack-textures.js)

text.tspan: RULE: prepare data once, offline, with a script in the repo;
at runtime use what the engine has natively (spritesheet JSON),
never re-implement slicing in game code.
2 WebGL textures, uploaded on first draw
